extension.summary: Shows your Home Assistant dashboard in Kodi
extension.description: Brings the contents of the Home Assistant "Home" dashboard into Kodi: your favourites, the light, climate, security, maintenance, weather and energy summaries, and every area grouped by floor. States update live over the WebSocket API, and devices can be switched straight from the couch.

Bringt den Inhalt des Home-Assistant-Dashboards „Home" nach Kodi: deine Favoriten, die Übersichten für Licht, Klima, Sicherheit, Wartung, Wetter und Energie sowie alle Räume nach Etagen gruppiert. Die Zustände aktualisieren sich live über die WebSocket-API, und Geräte lassen sich direkt vom Sofa aus schalten.
extension.news:
v1.4.0 - A video playing behind the dashboard shows through it
v1.3.0 - Media players open a window of their own: cover, what is playing, seeking, volume, shuffle and repeat, browsing, inputs, sound modes and joining players - States and option lists now read the way Home Assistant words them, in your language - A row's value has more room, and scrolls when the row is selected - Context menus offer only what a press would change: switching on or off, never both - The lists keep their place when the dashboard refreshes in the background - Fixed: playing a video while the dashboard was open made the sound drop out every few seconds - Fixed: the dashboard could freeze for half a minute while Home Assistant was answering
v1.2.0 - The section tiles no longer count their entities, which leaves the names more room - The energy summary is called "Energy" now: it lists what the energy dashboard is built from, it does not add up a day
v1.1.0 - Venetian blinds: open, close, stop and set the slats - Fans: speed, preset, oscillation and direction - Humidifiers: target humidity and mode - Valves: open, close, stop and position - The changelog is now shown in Kodi's addon browser
v1.0.0 - Initial release
